blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, inflatable kayaks, and tubes to float the Thornapple River. Rentals include premium canoes with backs, kayaks for one or two people, and cooler tubes for picnics or parties. The river float trips vary in duration from 3 to 6.5 hours depending on the route.
extraNote: Make a reservation to assure the watercraft you desire; walk-ins welcome · Meet at downtown Hastings location for shuttle to private launch near Charlton Park. · Spring, Summer, and Fall (weather and river conditions permitting)
